name: Experimental Research Volumetric Burden Categorization
citation: Research volumetric stratification derived from neuro-oncology volumetrics literature (BraTS benchmarks and RANO quantitative research volume quartiles). NOT clinically validated as a diagnostic grade or prognostic indicator.
disclaimer: Experimental research categorization based purely on segmented volumetric spatial extent (cm³). This does NOT constitute a clinical diagnosis, WHO tumor grade (Grade 1-4), cancer staging, or prognostic severity assessment, which require histopathological, molecular (e.g. IDH mutation, 1p/19q codeletion, MGMT methylation), and comprehensive clinical oncological evaluations.
